identifier.description: Email or username of the account to reset, matched the same way as sign in.

PasswordResetRequest.description: Asks for a password reset link. The answer is the same whether or not an account matches.

token.description: The one-time token from the reset link. It works once and expires 10 minutes after it was sent.

newPassword.description: The new password for the account.

confirmNewPassword.description: Repeat of the new password to guard against typing mistakes.

PasswordResetConfirmRequest.description: Sets a new password with a reset link. Every session of the account is signed out.

token.description: The one-time token from the link in the email sent to the old address. It works once and for 7 days.

EmailChangeUndoRequest.description: Puts back the email address an account had before a change. The password is replaced with a random one and every session of the account is signed out.

enabled.description: Whether any system email is sent. Off: every email is skipped and logged.

items.description: An email address, or @domain for every address at that domain.

allowedRecipients.description: When not empty, the only addresses email is sent to (addresses or @domain); every other recipient is skipped and logged. Empty: no limit.

sendRatePerSecond.description: The most emails each API server task sends a second. SES accounts start at 14 a second in all.

entryReminderHours.description: How many hours before a contest's picks close each entry reminder goes, to members with nothing submitted (#845). Everyone gets each reminder at the same moment.

standingsBufferMinutes.description: How many minutes after a round, week or event finishes its live standings email goes (#877), so a late score correction lands first.

weeklyDigestHour.description: The hour on Monday, US Eastern time, every weekly event digest goes (#851): one moment for every league, so it is waiting in the morning. The next day's "New member joined" email for a busy day goes at the same hour every day (#903).

templates.description: Per-template switches. A template that is off is skipped even while email is on.

EmailConfig.description: Whether and how system email is sent.

salaryCap.description: Whole dollars. The salary cap the prices are a share of, and the cap of every budget contest on the event.

unit.description: Whole dollars. Every price is rounded to a multiple of it. At most the worst golfer's price.

topSharePercent.description: The best seed's price, as a percentage of the salary cap.

floorSharePercent.description: The worst seed's price, as a percentage of the salary cap. At most `topSharePercent`.

steepness.description: How fast prices fall from the top: 1 is a straight line; higher keeps the top few expensive and drops the middle of the field towards the floor.

upsetBonus.description: The upset bonus: none, or the seed difference times a multiplier when a worse seed (a higher number) beats a better one. No bonus for equal seeds or when the better seed wins. An unseeded team counts as the field's worst seed.

multiplier.description: What each seed of difference is worth. 1 is the usual rule; 2 doubles the bonus.

config.description: Knockout round-points settings: the value of a win in each round and the upset bonus.

anyOf.description: Squares rules: claim boxes of a 10x10 grid on one game; the digits are drawn along each side, and the box at each scoring moment's last digits wins it.

reuseTeamsOnceAllUsed.description: Whether teams can be picked again once every team is used (#787). Each entry has its own cycle: once it has picked every team in the contest's weeks, each is usable once more. It matters only in a contest with more weeks than the league has teams. Left out, yes.

maxEntriesPerSquad.description: Maximum entries a Team may create. Null means unlimited.

scoring.description: The contest's scoring definition and its settings (a finish-position contest's points table). pointsTable.description: Points by finishing place: the first value is what the winner scores, the second second place, and so on, at most 50 places. Never increasing. A place beyond the table scores 0. Win / Place / Show is [5, 3, 1].

didNotFinishPoints.description: What a runner scores when it did not finish, was disqualified or did not start (including one scratched after picks closed). Usually 0.

scoringFamily.description: How the sport league's events are scored, when not as its sport's: COMPOSITE for a championship stat pool, each game a player's sport composite. Null takes the sport's. Set with the league's reference data, never by a request.

externalId.description: Provider-side event identifier used by sync operations. (Admin-only: operational detail no member surface reads.)

providerId.description: Provider that emitted the event, or manual-admin for an admin-authored one. (Admin-only: operational detail no member surface reads.)

name.description: Event name shown in contest and event selectors.

venue.description: Venue name when known; null otherwise.

location.description: Human-readable location when known; null otherwise.

status.description: Event lifecycle status.

endDate.description: Scheduled or actual end time when known; null otherwise.

rounds.description: Number of rounds when the format has them; null otherwise.

roundsPar.description: Par for every round, when an admin set it. Null: contest scoring derives each round's par from the field's finished rounds. Contest scoring uses it to turn an unplayed round's 80 strokes into to-par.

participantCount.description: Field size the provider reports, when it reports one; null otherwise.

loadedParticipantCount.description: Number of event participants currently persisted for the event.

untieredParticipantCount.description: Active event participants with no tier. A DRAFT event can't be released while any remain. (Admin-only: operational detail no member surface reads.)

unpricedParticipantCount.description: Active event participants with no price. A DRAFT event can't be released while any remain. (Admin-only: operational detail no member surface reads.)

pricing.description: The values the field was last priced with for budget contests, or null until prices are assigned. Locked at release; its salaryCap is the cap of every budget contest on the event.

salaryCap.description: Whole dollars. The salary cap the prices are a share of, and the cap of every budget contest on the event.

unit.description: Whole dollars. Every price is rounded to a multiple of it. At most the worst golfer's price.

topSharePercent.description: The best seed's price, as a percentage of the salary cap.

floorSharePercent.description: The worst seed's price, as a percentage of the salary cap. At most `topSharePercent`.

steepness.description: How fast prices fall from the top: 1 is a straight line; higher keeps the top few expensive and drops the middle of the field towards the floor.

profileName.description: The profile the values started from. The admin may have changed any value before assigning.

readinessReasons.description: Why the event is or is not contest-eligible right now: not released yet (DRAFT), no field loaded, or already started.

contestEligible.description: Whether a contest can be created on the event right now: it is released, its field is loaded, and it has not started.

eventSeriesId.description: The recurring tournament (event series) this is one edition of — the event's only parent.

eventYear.description: The year this edition is branded with ("the 2026 Masters"), which is not always the year startDate falls in. One edition of a series per year.

sportLeagueId.description: The sport league the event's series belongs to. Read through the series, not stored on the event.

participantType.description: Who competes, when the event's sport league overrides its sport: INDIVIDUAL in a championship stat pool. Null competes as the sport does. Read through the series' sport league.

scoringFamily.description: How the event is scored, when its sport league overrides its sport: COMPOSITE in a championship stat pool, played as golf's shape with each game a round. Null scores as the sport does. Read through the series' sport league.

syncScope.description: How much provider data this event accepts on sync. (Admin-only: operational detail no member surface reads.)

autoLifecycleEnabled.description: Whether the lifecycle scheduler may move this event's status. (Admin-only: operational detail no member surface reads.)

tierCount.description: Pick tiers defined for the event. A tiered contest's entry picks this many tiers times the contest's picksPerTier.

emptyTierLabels.description: Labels of the event's tiers no active participant is in, in tier order. A DRAFT event can't be released while any remain: no entry could pick from them. (Admin-only: operational detail no member surface reads.)

contestCount.description: Contests run on the event, across every league; an event with any cannot be deleted. (Admin-only: operational detail no member surface reads.)

allowedTransitions.description: Statuses the event may move to next, from the declared transition map. (Admin-only: operational detail no member surface reads.)

createdAt.description: When the event row was created.

updatedAt.description: When the event row was last updated.

teamAffiliation.description: Current team affiliation when the participant is not itself a team.

status.description: Current participant lifecycle or availability status.

source.description: Source that provided the injury-status update.

injuryStatus.description: Normalized participant injury or availability state.

photoLastUpdated.description: When the participant image metadata was last refreshed.

externalIds.description: Map of provider identifiers keyed by provider code.

createdAt.description: When the participant record was created.

updatedAt.description: When the participant record was last updated.

valuation.description: Null until a tier or price is set.

price.description: Price in a budget contest; null when unpriced.

standing.description: Null until the participant has a scored round, or a race result.

position.description: The participant's place within this event as it stands — its leaderboard position, direction-free: 1 is best in every sport. Not their rank coming in: that is the field row's `ranking`.

displayPosition.description: Position as shown, e.g. "T3".

status.description: ELIMINATED covers a missed cut; golf surfaces show it as "Cut".

golf.description: Present for a golf event with scores; null otherwise.

currentRoundThru.description: Holes completed in the current round.

status.description: Progress through the round.

golf.description: Present once a golf round is scored.

stat.description: One of the stats the sport's composite counts.

value.description: The player's count of it in the game; below 0 only for yards.

items.description: Composite extension of a participant round: one stat of a stat pool player's game.

statLines.description: A stat pool player's stats in the game, by stat; empty for every other event, and for a game the player has no line in.

items.description: A field row's part in one round.

race.description: Present once a race result is entered for a finish-position event (a horse race); null otherwise.

finishPosition.description: Finishing place, 1 for the winner; runners in a dead heat share a place. Set only when resultStatus is FINISHED; null until entered.

startPosition.description: Post position (or grid slot, or starting spot); null when not entered.

resultStatus.description: How the race ended for this runner. Every status but FINISHED scores the contest's "did not finish" points.

isOfficial.description: Whether the race's result is official. Contest scoring counts a result only once it is.

riderName.description: The jockey (or rider) for this start; null when not entered. The trainer is the participant's teamAffiliation.

affiliatedWithSportLeague.description: Whether the participant is affiliated with the event's sport league; false flags an invite from elsewhere. (Admin-only: operational detail no member surface reads.)

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime string.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime string.

participant.description: A participant on an event's field, with everything the event records about them.

externalId.description: The participant's canonical external id.

items.description: One uploaded field row. The first identifier present is used — participantId, then externalId, then an exact case-insensitive playerName — matched only within the event's field, with no fallback to the next. Each value omitted is left alone; null clears it.

SportEventParticipantUploadRequest.description: A field upload: changes to participants already on the event's field. It never adds one.

externalId.description: The participant's canonical external id.

row.description: One uploaded field row. The first identifier present is used — participantId, then externalId, then an exact case-insensitive playerName — matched only within the event's field, with no fallback to the next. Each value omitted is left alone; null clears it.

resolution.description: MATCHED: one participant on the field. UNRESOLVED: none on the field — the upload never adds one, so load the field from the provider first. AMBIGUOUS: several.

sportEventParticipantId.description: The field row it resolved to; set only when MATCHED.

rowError.description: Set when a MATCHED row still cannot be applied.

change.description: Null when the row cannot be applied.

before.description: What is stored now; set whenever the row resolved.

after.description: What applying would store; null when the row cannot be applied.

message.description: Why the row cannot be applied, for display; null when it can.

items.description: What applying one uploaded field row would do.

rows.description: One per uploaded row, in upload order.

update.description: Rows that would change a value.

rollup.description: Counts by resolution and by change. Apply succeeds only when matched equals total and duplicate is 0.

name.description: Contest name shown to commissioners and members.

sportEventIds.description: The events the contest covers (#713): one for a golf or race contest, several for a majors pool or a season. All from one sport league, each released, with its field loaded and not yet started. The contest keeps them in start-date order, whatever order they are sent in.

contestFormat.description: ROSTER: entries pick a lineup from the field. PREDICTION: entries pick the winners of games (#716). SQUARES: entries claim boxes of a grid on one game (#711). It must be the format the selection type plays (PICK_EM, BRACKET and SURVIVOR are PREDICTION, SQUARES is SQUARES, every other type ROSTER) and one the event's tournament format allows: 422 CONTEST_FORMAT_NOT_ALLOWED otherwise.

selectionType.description: How an entry picks: the selection types with typed rules. It must match the template's selection type when a template is named, and the configuration's.

templateId.description: Template whose configuration seeds the contest. Optional: the first step of creation, not a second way to create.

configuration.description: The contest configuration. With a template, replaces the template's configuration; without one, is the configuration.

picksPerTier.description: How many golfers an entry picks from each of the event's tiers. The entry's total picks is the event's tier count times this.

countedScores.description: How many golfer scores count toward the entry total, best first. At most the roster size.

tiersUsed.description: How many of the event's tiers an entry picks from, the first ones in tier order (tennis's "Seeds only": the first four). Left out, every tier. The event owns its tiers (#249), so this is the contest's rule, not a second tier layout.

maxEntriesPerSquad.description: Maximum entries a Team may create. Null means unlimited.

scoring.description: The contest's scoring definition and its settings (a finish-position contest's points table). Omitted on create, the template's preset applies, else the sport's default definition with its default settings; a definition whose settings have no default (finish-position points) must then be sent. Omitted on a rules change, the contest keeps its scoring.

pointsTable.description: Points by finishing place: the first value is what the winner scores, the second second place, and so on, at most 50 places. Never increasing. A place beyond the table scores 0. Win / Place / Show is [5, 3, 1].

didNotFinishPoints.description: What a runner scores when it did not finish, was disqualified or did not start (including one scratched after picks closed). Usually 0.

config.description: Finish-position points settings: the contest's points table and its "did not finish" value.

roundValues.description: Points for a win in each round, round 1 first, one value per round of the event (at most 8). Doubling for a six-round bracket is [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32].

upsetBonus.description: The upset bonus: none, or the seed difference times a multiplier when a worse seed (a higher number) beats a better one. No bonus for equal seeds or when the better seed wins. An unseeded team counts as the field's worst seed.

multiplier.description: What each seed of difference is worth. 1 is the usual rule; 2 doubles the bonus.

config.description: Knockout round-points settings: the value of a win in each round and the upset bonus.

anyOf.description: Tiered rules: pick the same number of golfers from every tier of the event, or from its first tiersUsed tiers.

rosterSize.description: How many golfers an entry picks, from anywhere in the field.

CreateContestRequest.description: Request payload for creating a contest.

UpdateContestRequest.description: Patch payload for updating editable contest metadata.

name.description: Unique entry name shown anywhere the team entry is listed.

tiebreakerValue.description: Optional tiebreaker prediction saved on the contest entry. Refused with 400 CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH on a prediction contest, whose tiebreaker is saved with its game picks (#721).

UpdateContestEntryRequest.description: Request payload for updating a contest entry while the contest is still joinable.

sportEventId.description: The event.

sequence.description: The event's place in the contest, 1 first: the contest's events in start-date order.

name.description: The event's name.

startDate.description: The event's scheduled start: when its picks close.

status.description: The event's own status. Each event of a contest is picked, submitted, played and settled on its own (#713).

participantType.description: Who competes, when the event's sport league overrides its sport: INDIVIDUAL in a championship stat pool. Null competes as the sport does. The same on every event of a contest, which covers one sport league.

scoringFamily.description: How the event is scored, when its sport league overrides its sport: COMPOSITE in a championship stat pool. Null scores as the sport does. The same on every event of a contest, which covers one sport league.

sportEventIds.description: Every event the contest should cover: the ones it keeps and the ones added. An event left out is removed. Kept in start-date order.

SetContestSportEventsRequest.description: Request payload for setting the events a contest covers.

cupWeight.description: How much the contest counts toward its cup and the league championship: NORMAL x1, BONUS x1.5, DOUBLE x2, NOT_COUNTED not at all.

SetContestCupWeightRequest.description: Request payload for setting how much a contest counts toward its cup and the championship.

sportEventId.description: One event of the entry's contest.

status.description: DRAFT until the owner submits a complete lineup for this event; only a SUBMITTED event counts on the leaderboard, in standings and at settlement (#481, per event since #713).

submittedAt.description: When the event's picks were submitted; null while a draft.

ContestEntryEventDto.description: An entry's status in one event of its contest (#713): "submit week 6".

sportEventId.description: The event.

totalScore.description: The entry's score in the event: the sum of its counting picks' contest scores there, or, for an event it missed, a missed lineup's score (golf: 80 strokes a round for each counted pick). Null until a pick is scored.

position.description: The entry's rank in the event, 1 best; null while unscored. Once the event is settled, an entry that missed it ranks too, scored as a missed lineup (#714).

displayPosition.description: Position as shown, "T" prefixed for a tie.

ContestEntryEventResultDto.description: An entry's result in one event of its contest (#713): one week's score, one major's.

sportEventId.description: The contest event whose field and picks to show; its picks must be revealed. Defaults to the contest's latest event whose picks are revealed.

entriesPerContest.description: The most entries the contest takes, every squad's drafts included: its league plan's cap or its expansion (#987), whichever is higher. Null for no limit.

drawnAt.description: When a random-draw contest's draw dealt its picks (#601). From then on its entries are closed, though it stays OPEN until its event starts. Null until then, and for every other selection type.

events.description: The entry's status in each event of its contest, in the contest's event order.

picksCount.description: Number of roster picks currently saved on this entry. Always populated, even when picks are hidden from non-owners.

createdAt.description: When the contest entry was created.

updatedAt.description: When the contest entry was last updated.

participants.description: The entry's picked participants, each naming its event. To anyone but the owning squad only the picks of events whose picks are revealed are listed. Omitted on the entry writes, which return the entry without them.

sportEventId.description: The event of the contest the pick is in (#713).

role.description: The participant's playing role, when known.

pickedAt.description: When the participant was added to the contest entry.

items.description: Contest entry participant detail. Picks remain pointers to event participants; scores are returned by the contest leaderboard endpoint.

sportEventParticipantId.description: Per-event participant the pick refers to (Sport-event-participant row, not the canonical Participant).

contestFormat.description: Denormalized from parent Contest.contestFormat. Plans/117 §7.1 — enables per-format partial unique indexes that Postgres cannot predicate on joined parent columns.

period.description: Unused: no built contest format sets it, so it is always null. Removal is tracked in #632.

slot.description: Unused: no built contest format sets it, so it is always null; a lineup position is `lineupSlot`. Removal is tracked in #632.

isAutoPicked.description: Whether this pick was auto-assigned rather than submitted by the entry. Always false for tiered and budget selection, which have no auto-pick.

lineupSlot.description: Position of this pick within its entry's roster. Tiered: counted across tier quotas in tier order; budget: the entry's pick ordinal. Null when the pick was not recorded through contest selection.

pickSequence.description: Contest-wide order in which this pick was recorded, across all entries. Null when the pick was not recorded through contest selection.

pickedAt.description: When the pick was made (or auto-picked).

ContestEntryPickDto.description: Raw ContestEntryPick row used by persistence-aware surfaces.

role.description: The participant's playing role, when known.

pickedAt.description: When the participant was added to the contest entry.

ContestEntryParticipantDetailDto.description: Contest entry participant detail. Picks remain pointers to event participants; scores are returned by the contest leaderboard endpoint.

scoreToPar.description: The golfer's score in this contest against par: their event total, with every round they did not play scored as 80 strokes (80 minus that round's par). Differs from the event standing's eventScoreToPar only when unplayedRoundNumbers is non-empty. Null while unscored.

unplayedRoundNumbers.description: Rounds scored as 80 strokes because the golfer did not play them: cut, withdrawn, removed from the field, or no score once the field moved past the round. Empty when none.

ScoredContestEntryPickGolfDto.description: Golf extension of a scored pick: the golfer's contest score and the rounds in it scored as 80 strokes.

sportEventParticipantId.description: The picked field row. Its scores are the matching entry of `participants`; a pick is a pointer, not a copy.

slot.description: Optional roster slot from the pick row.

isCounting.description: Whether this pick currently counts toward the entry's total under the counting rule.

isDropped.description: Whether this scored pick is currently dropped because better picks fill the counting places.

golf.description: Present for a golf contest; null otherwise.

scoreToPar.description: The golfer's score in this contest against par: their event total, with every round they did not play scored as 80 strokes (80 minus that round's par). Differs from the event standing's eventScoreToPar only when unplayedRoundNumbers is non-empty. Null while unscored.

unplayedRoundNumbers.description: Rounds scored as 80 strokes because the golfer did not play them: cut, withdrawn, removed from the field, or no score once the field moved past the round. Empty when none.

race.description: Present for a finish-position contest (a horse race); null otherwise.

points.description: The runner's points in this contest: the contest's points table at its finishing place (0 beyond the table), or its "did not finish" points when it did not finish, was disqualified, did not start or was scratched. Null until the race result is official.

knockout.description: Present for a head-to-head contest (a basketball bracket); null otherwise.

points.description: The team's points in this contest: each round it won a match in scores that round's value, plus the upset bonus when the contest has one on. Null until the bracket has a result.

upsetBonusPoints.description: The part of the points that is upset bonus; 0 when the bonus is off.

isAlive.description: False once the team has lost a match.

composite.description: Present for a championship stat pool, scored by composite; null otherwise.

points.description: The player's score in this contest: their games' composites summed, a game they did not play scoring 0. Null until the event's first game has stat lines.

roundNumber.description: The game: the event's round number.

score.description: The player's composite for the game, from its stat lines. Can be below 0 where yards are lost.

items.description: One game a stat pool player played, and their composite in it.

games.description: Each game the player has stat lines for, in round order. A game they did not play is left out; its stats are on the participant's rounds.

sportEventParticipantId.description: With TEAM, the team picked to win: the field row of one of the two teams the game offers the entry. In a bracket a later game offers the teams the entry picked to win the games before it. Null with TIE.

confidence.description: A confidence pool's value for this pick, 1 to the week's number of games. Omitted or null in a straight-up pool, and until the entry gives one. A value may repeat until the week is submitted.

items.description: One game's pick as it is saved.

picks.description: The picks to save, one per game; may be empty when only the tiebreaker changes. Each replaces the entry's pick on that game; the entry's other picks are kept, except that in a bracket a later pick that no longer follows from the entry's picks is cleared, and in a survivor pool, which takes one pick, the entry's pick on another game is cleared. Saved together or not at all, so two confidence values can be swapped, or a whole bracket filled, in one request.

tiebreakerValue.description: The event's tiebreaker: the total points the entry expects in its tiebreaker game (`tiebreakerMatchId`: a bracket's final, a pick'em week's last game), both teams together. Required before submit; null clears it, omitted leaves it as it is. Refused with 409 CONTEST_ENTRY_LOCKED once that game's pick has locked.

SaveGamePicksRequest.description: Request payload for saving an entry's picks on one event's games.

weekNumber.description: 1 for the contest's first week, by start date.

roundNumber.description: The round of the event the week is (#785): 1 for a regular-season week, which is an event of one round; each round of a playoff bracket is a week of its own.

roundCount.description: The event's number of rounds, for the round's name: 1 for a regular-season week.

name.description: The event's name; a playoff round is named by its round number and the event's round names.

started.description: Whether the week's first game has kicked off: an entry not submitted by then is out.

aliveCount.description: How many entries are still in after the week: those that survived it and those whose game is still to finish. 0 until it starts, and for a cancelled week.

items.description: One week of a survivor contest: a regular-season week, or one round of a playoff bracket.

weeks.description: The contest's weeks in week order.

alive.description: Whether the entry is still in.

eliminatedInWeek.description: The week number that put the entry out; null while it is in.

weeksSurvived.description: The weeks the entry survived: its score.

position.description: The entry's place: entries still in first, then by weeks survived. Entries out in the same week share a place, as do entries still in at the end.

displayPosition.description: The place as shown, "T2" when shared.

roundNumber.description: The round of the event the week is, as on the contest's weeks.

outcome.description: SURVIVED when the picked team won or its game was cancelled, ELIMINATED after a loss, a tie or a week not submitted by its first kickoff, PENDING while the game is unplayed. Null before the week starts, for a cancelled week, and for weeks after the entry went out.

team.description: The team the entry picked, once its game has kicked off. Null before then, and with no pick.

items.description: One entry's week of a survivor contest.

weeks.description: The entry's result for each of the contest's weeks, in week order.

items.description: One entry's standing in a survivor contest.

entries.description: The entries that submitted at least one week, best first.

SurvivorLeaderboardResponse.description: A survivor contest's leaderboard: who is still in, and when each entry went out.

againstTheSpread.description: Whether picks are scored against each game's spread.

started.description: Whether the week's first game has kicked off: until then no entry has points for it.

settled.description: Whether the week has settled: its points and places are frozen, and a later result correction changes nothing. A cancelled week, or a completed week no entry submitted, is settled with nothing frozen.

gameCount.description: The week's games, cancelled ones left out. None when the week was cancelled.

tiebreakerTotalPoints.description: The week's last game's combined score once it is played: what the week's tiebreakers are measured against.

winnerEntryIds.description: The week's winners, the entries in first place once the week has settled; more than one when they are still level after the tiebreaker. Empty until it settles.

items.description: One week of a pick'em contest.

weeks.description: The contest's weeks in its week order.

position.description: The entry's place in the season, by total points. Entries level share a place. Null until a week the entry submitted has started.

displayPosition.description: The place as shown, "T2" when shared.

totalPoints.description: The season total so far: the sum of the entry's points over the weeks that have started.

submitted.description: Whether the entry submitted the week. A week still in draft at its first kickoff scores nothing.

points.description: The entry's points for the week: 1 for each correct pick straight up, the pick's confidence value in a confidence pool. Null until the week starts, and for a week it did not submit or that was cancelled.

position.description: The entry's place in the week: by points, then, once the week's last game is played, by how close its tiebreaker was to that game's total points. Null where points is.

displayPosition.description: The place as shown, "T2" when shared.

weeklyWinner.description: Whether the entry won the week: first place once the week has settled.

items.description: One entry's result for one week of a pick'em contest.

weeks.description: The entry's result for each of the contest's weeks, in the contest's week order.

items.description: One entry's standing in a pick'em contest.

entries.description: The entries that submitted at least one week, best first.

PickEmLeaderboardResponse.description: A pick'em contest's season leaderboard: the season total, each week's points and places, and the weekly winners.

eventCancelled.description: The event was cancelled: it counts for nothing, so every entry stands unscored and no game counts.

gameCount.description: The bracket's games: an entry picks each one. None when the event was cancelled.

finalTotalPoints.description: The final's combined score, both teams together, once it is played: what the tiebreakers are measured against.

position.description: The entry's place: by points, then, once the final is played, by how close its tiebreaker was to the final's total points. Entries still level share a place.

displayPosition.description: The place as shown, "T2" when shared.

points.description: Points so far: each correct pick's round value plus any upset bonus.

maxPossiblePoints.description: Points so far plus the round value of every pick whose team is still in: the most the entry can still reach.

tiebreakerValue.description: The entry's guess of the final's total points.

items.description: One entry's standing in a bracket contest.

entries.description: The entries that submitted their bracket, best first. An entry still in draft when the event started is left out.

mode.description: A pick'em pool's mode; null in a bracket or survivor pool.

againstTheSpread.description: Whether picks are scored against each game's spread: a pick names the team that covers. Only a pick'em pool can be.

tiePicksOffered.description: Whether a pick may say the game ends level (#792): a pick'em pool in a sport that offers tie picks, a draw in soccer. False in a bracket or survivor pool.

survivor.description: A survivor pool's season for the entry; null in the other pools.

eliminatedInWeek.description: The week number (1 for the contest's first week) that put the entry out: a loss, a tie, or a week not submitted by its first kickoff. Null while it is still in. An entry that is out picks no later week.

usedParticipantIds.description: The teams, by participant id, the entry picked in its other submitted weeks: it cannot pick them again. Null on another team's entry, as they could show picks not yet revealed.

status.description: The entry's status for this event: DRAFT while picking, SUBMITTED once every game is picked and submitted. Only a submitted event counts.

ownEntry.description: Whether the caller is on the entry's team, and so sees every pick on it.

canSubmit.description: Whether the caller can submit the event now: their own draft entry, every game picked with valid confidence values and the tiebreaker given, before the first game starts.

pickedCount.description: How many of the games have a pick. Counted on the caller's own entry; on another team's, only revealed games are counted.

tiebreakerMatchId.description: The game whose total points the tiebreaker guesses: a bracket's final, a pick'em week's last game by kickoff. Null while there is none.

tiebreakerValue.description: The entry's tiebreaker for the event, the tiebreaker game's total points. Null when not given, and on another team's entry until that game's picks are revealed.

points.description: Points so far: a bracket's round values and upset bonuses, a pick'em pick's 1 point, or its confidence value, for each correct pick. Null on another team's entry until all its picks are revealed.

maxPossiblePoints.description: Points so far plus what every pick still pending is worth: the most the entry can still reach. Null where points is.

kickoff.description: When the game starts: its scheduled time, else its event's start. Its pick locks then.

regionLabel.description: The bracket region or conference the game is in ("East", "AFC"), for grouping on screen; null where the bracket has none.

homeSpread.description: The points spread from the home team's side (#720): -3.5 has the home team favoured by 3.5. Null until set.

home.description: The team really playing on this side; null until it is decided.

sportEventParticipantId.description: The team's field row in the event: what a pick names.

away.description: The team really playing on this side; null until it is decided.

sportEventParticipantId.description: The team's field row in the event: what a pick names.

predictedHome.description: The team the entry's own picks put on this side, which its pick chooses between: in a bracket, the team it picked to win the game feeding this side (in a reseeded round, its picked winners paired by seed); otherwise the real team. Null until the picks that decide it are made. On another team's entry, the real team until the game is revealed.

sportEventParticipantId.description: The team's field row in the event: what a pick names.

predictedAway.description: As predictedHome, for the away side.

sportEventParticipantId.description: The team's field row in the event: what a pick names.

locked.description: Whether the game's pick can no longer change: it has kicked off, or the contest no longer takes picks.

revealed.description: Whether picks on this game are shown to the whole league: from its kickoff once the contest is live.

pick.description: The entry's pick on the game. Null when it has none, and on another team's entry until the game is revealed.

predictedResult.description: What the pick says happens: TEAM, its team wins; TIE, the game ends level (#792).

sportEventParticipantId.description: The team picked to win; null for a TIE pick.

confidence.description: The pick's confidence value; null in a straight-up pool, in a bracket, or until given.

outcome.description: How the pick stands against the results: CORRECT once its team won the game (in a bracket, its round; against the spread, covered), or for a TIE pick once the game ended level, BUSTED once it can no longer come true (a loss, a tie, a failure to cover, or in a bracket its team out), PUSH against the spread when the game landed exactly on it, else PENDING.

points.description: What the pick earned when CORRECT: in a bracket its round's value plus any upset bonus, in a pick'em pool 1 point straight up or its confidence value. 0 when BUSTED or PUSH, null while PENDING or not scored.

items.description: One game of the event with the entry's pick on it.

games.description: The event's games in game-number order. Cancelled games are left out: they are not picked.

GamePicksResponse.description: A prediction contest entry's picks on one event's games.

LoadSportEventBracketRequest.description: The whole bracket: it replaces every match the event has. Each team appears at most once, there is exactly one final in the last round named, and two matches never advance to the same side.

homeSportEventParticipantId.description: Omitted keeps it; null empties the side. Only until the event is released.

awaySportEventParticipantId.description: Omitted keeps it; null empties the side. Only until the event is released.

scheduledDate.description: Omitted keeps it; null clears it.

homeSpread.description: The points spread from the home team's side, in half points (-3.5: the home team favoured by 3.5). Omitted keeps it; null clears it. Once the event is released, only while nobody has picked the game.

UpdateSportEventMatchRequest.description: One match edit. Its time and site can change at any point; its sides only until the event is released; its spread until someone picks the game.

participantId.description: The team that won the play-in game: an active participant of the event's sport not yet on the field.

FillPlayInSlotRequest.description: The play-in winner for a field row that stands for a play-in pairing ("Texas / Xavier"). The row then names the winner and keeps its seed, tier, price and picks; the pairing's participant is inactivated.

participantId.description: Who takes the place: an active participant of the event's sport not yet on the field, such as a tennis lucky loser.

ReplaceWithdrawnParticipantRequest.description: A replacement for a field row that withdrew before its first match. The replacement gets its own field row in the withdrawn row's bracket place, unseeded, last in the event's last tier and at its lowest price. The withdrawn row stays on the field, inactive as WITHDRAWN, and every pick of it scores as a first-round loss.

winnerSide.description: The side that won; null for a tie (#792), which needs both scores, level. Only a game of a week, which forms no bracket, can end in a tie.

homeScore.description: The home side's score (games won, for a series), or null with the away score null too.

awayScore.description: The away side's score, or null with the home score null too.

homeShootoutScore.description: The home side's kicks scored in a shoot-out, for a bracket match level after extra time in a sport settled that way; omitted or null with the away side's for none.

awayShootoutScore.description: The away side's kicks scored in a shoot-out; omitted or null with the home side's.

ending.description: How the match ended; omitted is PLAYED. A RETIREMENT or DEFAULT takes both scores or neither, and the winner's may be the lower (where it stopped); a WALKOVER takes no scores. Neither a tie nor a shoot-out ends early.

RecordSportEventMatchResultRequest.description: A match's result: who won, or a tie, and both scores or neither. A match that ended early says how (ending). The winner's score must be the higher, except in a bracket match of a sport settled by shoot-out, where a level score takes both shoot-out scores and the winner's shoot-out score is the higher. Shoot-out scores are refused anywhere else. A tie, only in a game of a week, has level scores.

homeScore.description: The home side's score at the end of the period, earlier periods included.

awayScore.description: The away side's score at the end of the period, earlier periods included.

RecordSportEventMatchPeriodScoreRequest.description: Both sides' score at the end of one period, as the scoreboard shows it. Neither may be below its score at an earlier period's end, or above its score at a later one's or its final score.

awaySportEventParticipantId.description: The field row on the away side.

201.description: Successful authentication response returned after registration or login.

post.description: Rotates the refresh-token session forward and returns a new token bundle. Browser clients normally rely on the refresh cookie rather than sending a body payload.

post.description: Public. Looks up the account by email or username and, when one matches, emails it a link that sets a new password. The link works once and expires after 10 minutes, and a newer request cancels it. The answer is 202 whether or not an account matched, so it never tells a caller which emails or usernames have accounts. 429 PASSWORD_RESET_RATE_LIMITED when this address has asked too often in the last minute.

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset link
post.description: Public; the token from the reset link is the whole authority. Sets the new password, cancels the account's other reset links and signs the account out on every device; the caller then signs in with the new password. 400 PASSWORD_RESET_LINK_INVALID for a link that is unknown, used, cancelled or expired (one code for all four), 400 PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH when the two passwords differ, 429 PASSWORD_RESET_RATE_LIMITED when this address has tried too often in the last minute.

post.summary: Put back an account's old email address
post.description: Public; the token from the link in the "your email address was changed" email, sent to the old address, is the whole authority. Puts the old address back, replaces the password with a random one nobody knows (an account without a password stays without one), cancels the links from any later email change and the account's open reset links, and signs the account out on every device; the caller then resets the password, which now reaches the old address. The link works once and for 7 days. 400 EMAIL_CHANGE_UNDO_LINK_INVALID for a link that is unknown, used, cancelled or expired (one code for all four), 409 EMAIL_CHANGE_UNDO_ADDRESS_TAKEN when another account has the old address now, 429 EMAIL_CHANGE_UNDO_RATE_LIMITED when this address has tried too often in the last minute.

get.description: Returns the users matching `search`: a case-insensitive substring of the email, username, first or last name. This is the unscoped read: access rule A1 permits it to root admins only. Not paged — filters narrow the result, nothing slices it. `search` is required, at least 3 characters once trimmed, so the list never reads every user: 400 SEARCH_TERM_REQUIRED otherwise.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the email, username, first or last name; at least 3 characters once trimmed.

get.description: Returns one user as the canonical UserDto. `me` resolves to the authenticated caller. Access rule A6: the subject themselves, or a root admin. Carries no viewer context (A8).

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

delete.description: Removes the user row and the user-owned data that references it, in one transaction. Self-delete and admin-delete are ONE operation (A6). Gated: the account must already be inactive — the one place isActive is a write precondition rather than a read filter (A9) — the exact email must be confirmed, no league-scoped data may remain, and the last root admin cannot be removed.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

put.description: Updates email, first name and last name. One operation for either caller — the subject themselves or a root admin (A6). The email must be unique across account emails and usernames.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

put.description: Updates the login username after confirming it is unique across usernames AND emails, because login accepts either.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

put.description: Updates the time zone, locale and 12- or 24-hour clock the member sees dates in. An omitted field is left unchanged; an explicit null clears it. An unknown time zone answers 400 TIME_ZONE_UNKNOWN, a malformed locale 400 LOCALE_UNKNOWN.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

get.summary: Read which categories of email a user gets
get.description: One switch per category of email a member can turn off, the same for every league; account and membership emails have none. Also says why the address gets no email at all, when it bounced for good or was marked as spam. Access rule A6: the subject themselves, or a root admin.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

200.description: Which categories of email the user gets, and whether their address can be emailed at all.

put.summary: Turn one category of email on or off
put.description: Sets one category's switch and returns them all. The same switch an email's "Stop these emails" link turns off. Access rule A6: the subject themselves, or a root admin.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

200.description: Which categories of email the user gets, and whether their address can be emailed at all.

get.summary: List the payments a user made
get.description: Every payment the user made, in any of their leagues, newest first (#987): date, amount in US cents, what it was for and the league. While payments are off, each expansion is a $0 line that says it was free. No card data is kept. Access rule A6: the subject themselves, or a root admin.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

200.description: Every payment a user made, in any league.

post.summary: Change your own password
post.description: Changes the password after validating the current one. Self only (A6): a root admin resetting somebody else uses the reset operation, which has a different subject rather than merely a different precondition. Other sessions are revoked while the caller stays signed in.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

post.summary: Reset another user's password
post.description: Generates a temporary password for the target user, revokes their live sessions, and returns the credential for the root admin to relay. Root admin only (A6).

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

post.summary: Disable a user
post.description: Sets isActive = false and revokes every live session, atomically, except, when you inactivate yourself, the cookie session you did it from (A9: an inactive account may still sign in to reactivate or delete itself). Self-inactivation and admin-disable are ONE operation (A6). Idempotent: already inactive succeeds unchanged. Rejected for the last remaining active root admin.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

post.summary: Enable a user
post.description: Sets isActive = true. Self-reactivation and admin-enable are ONE operation (A6). Idempotent. Re-enabling yourself rotates a fresh session so the account is immediately usable.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

post.summary: Revoke every live session for a user
post.description: Revokes all refresh tokens, forcing re-authentication. Self sign-out-everywhere and admin force-logout are ONE operation (A6).

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

post.summary: Grant or revoke the root-admin role
post.description: Root admin only (A6). Self-demotion is permitted: the only rule is that the platform keeps an administrator, which the last-root-admin guard enforces for every caller. A demotion also revokes the subject's sessions so the removed authority cannot be used until re-login.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

get.description: Returns non-secret deployment metadata for the core API service so QA and operators can diagnose stale releases, SHA mismatches, and build provenance.

200.description: Public service version metadata for deployment and stale-release diagnostics.

get.description:
Returns leagues together with the viewer's own memberships once as an array. The leagues list is the one inherently multi-league surface, so it is the one place the viewer's relationship travels as a set rather than per row (access rule A8).

`scope` selects which leagues: `mine` (the default) returns the leagues the caller belongs to and powers the welcome page, header selector and My Leagues overview; `all` returns every league on the platform and powers root-admin league management. `all` is the unscoped read access rule A1 permits to root admins only, and returns 403 otherwise; it also requires `search` (at least 3 characters once trimmed), so it never reads every league, and returns 400 SEARCH_TERM_REQUIRED without one. `search` and `isActive` narrow either scope.

This replaced `listLeagues` + `adminListLeagues`, which were one operation split by caller role.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Which leagues to return: 'mine' (default) for the leagues the caller belongs to, 'all' for every league on the platform. 'all' requires root-admin access.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against the league name. A filter, never a slice — see §16. Optional for 'mine'; required for 'all', at least 3 characters.

parameters.name: isActive
parameters.description: Optional active/inactive filter. Omitted returns both.

200.description: League-list response, with the viewer's memberships once as an array.

post.summary: Create a new league
post.description:
Creates a new private league for the authenticated commissioner using the submitted unique `leagueCode`, then returns the new league together with the creator's own membership edges in it.

The same `LeagueContextResponse` as `getLeague` and `getLeagueByCode`, because creating a league also creates the creator's COMMISSIONER membership: the client navigates straight into the league and seeds its context cache from this response rather than issuing a second read (access rule A8). Creating a league also gives the creator their default squad, so `squadMembership`, `squadName` and `activeTeamCount` describe it.

201.description: A league together with the viewer's own membership edges in it. Fetched once per league; nothing else repeats this context.

get.summary: Get a league and the viewer's context in it, by ID
get.description:
Returns a league by internal league ID together with the viewer's own membership edges in it — their LeagueMembership and their SquadMembership — for authenticated league members, league commissioners, or root admins using platform-level override access.

The same `LeagueContextResponse` as `getLeagueByCode`: two ways to find one league, one response shape. Use this route when you hold a league ID rather than a league code, as contest-rooted surfaces do (access rule A8).

404 LEAGUE_NOT_FOUND for a league that does not exist; otherwise active members only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE.

200.description: A league together with the viewer's own membership edges in it. Fetched once per league; nothing else repeats this context.

delete.description:
Permanently deletes an inactive league after the caller types the exact `leagueCode` confirmation. This removes league-owned data and relationships while preserving user accounts.

One operation for both callers: a commissioner of the league, or a root admin exercising platform authority. This replaced `deleteLeague` + `adminDeleteLeague`.

get.summary: Get league details by league code
get.description: The league-context call. Returns a league by its stable league code together with the viewer's own membership edges in it — their LeagueMembership and their SquadMembership. This is the preferred route for bookmarkable `/league/<leagueCode>` web navigation, it allows root-admin override access without faking league membership, and it is the one response that carries viewer context: every other league-scoped response omits it because the client already holds this one (access rule A8).

200.description: A league together with the viewer's own membership edges in it. Fetched once per league; nothing else repeats this context.

put.description: Allows a commissioner to edit an active league's name, description and built-in icon in one request, so the change applies whole or not at all. League code remains immutable after creation.

Allows a commissioner to set an active league's championship name and points table (#841, #863) in one request. Cups score on read, so they follow the new table at once; the championship keeps the points each contest earned when it went final. 400 CUP_CUSTOM_POINTS_INVALID when CUSTOM has no points or another scale sends some; LEAGUE_DETAILS_READ_ONLY_WHEN_INACTIVE for an inactive league. 403 PLAN_FEATURE_NOT_INCLUDED, its `details.feature` naming what is missing, unless the league's plan has CUP_SETTINGS (root admins too). Changing hallOfLameVisible also needs RECORD_BOOK, the same 403 otherwise.

Moves an active league to another plan (#945): any commissioner of the league, or a root admin, may pick a plan at any time, free, and it applies at once. A plan whose `commissionerSelectable` is false only a root admin may pick. Every change is logged with who made it; picking the plan the league is already on changes and logs nothing. A lower plan only stops new things: nothing the league already has is removed. Returns the league with its new `planEntitlements`. 400 LEAGUE_DETAILS_READ_ONLY_WHEN_INACTIVE for an inactive league; 400 LEAGUE_PLAN_NOT_AVAILABLE when a commissioner picks a plan not offered yet; 409 LEAGUE_PLAN_CHANGED when someone else changed the plan during this change, which then changes and logs nothing.

post.summary: Extend every running gifted plan
post.description: Root admin only (#986). Moves the renewal date of every league whose gifted plan still runs out to `months` from now; a league whose date is already later keeps it. Each move is logged with who made it, from which date and to which. Returns how many leagues moved and the date they moved to.

200.description: What extending every running gifted plan did.

post.summary: Extend the league's gifted plan
post.description: Root admin only (#986). Moves the league's renewal date out to `months` from now, logged with who made it, from which date and to which; a date already later is kept and nothing is logged. The plan itself does not change. Returns the league with its new `planRenewsAt`. 404 LEAGUE_NOT_FOUND for a missing league.

put.summary: Choose which sport leagues' upcoming events the commissioners are emailed about
put.description: Allows a commissioner to set which sport leagues an active league's commissioners are not emailed about (#851): "Coming up soon" about 10 days before an event, and "Ready for contests" once it is released. The list is replaced whole; [] hears about every sport league, the default. 400 SPORT_LEAGUE_NOT_FOUND for an id that is not a sport league; LEAGUE_DETAILS_READ_ONLY_WHEN_INACTIVE for an inactive league.

post.summary: Inactivate a league
post.description:
Marks a league inactive. Inactive leagues remain visible, but this action is the required first step before a permanent delete becomes available.

One operation for both callers: a commissioner of the league, or a root admin exercising platform authority. This replaced `inactivateLeague` + `adminInactivateLeague`.

post.summary: Activate a league
post.description: Allows a commissioner to reactivate an inactive league so normal league usage and commissioner edits become available again.

post.summary: Send email invitations to join a league
post.description: Creates direct email invitations for the target league and queues each one's email; each sent invitation carries its email status. Existing members and pending duplicate invitees are reported separately in the response. An inactive league refuses with 400 `LEAGUE_INACTIVE`.

get.description: Lists the league's outstanding invitations, newest first: every PENDING email invite and join link, plus email invites that expired without being accepted, each email invite with where its latest email stands. Accepted and cancelled invitations are not listed. Commissioner only.

200.description: Commissioner list of a league's pending invitations.

post.summary: Resend an email invitation
post.description: Renews an outstanding email invitation: a new invite code (the old link stops working), a new expiry, and the invitation email queued again. 409 LEAGUE_INVITATION_NOT_RESENDABLE for a join link or an accepted or cancelled invitation, and 409 LEAGUE_INACTIVE while the league is inactive. Commissioner only.

post.summary: Generate a shareable invite link
post.description: Creates a reusable invitation link for the target league. The resulting invite code is later previewed through the public invitation endpoints. An inactive league refuses with 400 `LEAGUE_INACTIVE`.

delete.description: Cancels an outstanding invitation by its invite code, a shareable join link or an email invite, so the code can no longer be accepted. The invitation becomes REVOKED. An invitation already accepted or cancelled is refused with 409 LEAGUE_INVITATION_NOT_CANCELLABLE.

get.description: Returns the current league membership list for authenticated members and commissioners. This powers member rosters and commissioner management surfaces.

200.description: League-members response. Each member is the membership edge with the user embedded.

put.summary: Change a member role and permissions
put.description: Allows a commissioner to promote or demote a member within the league.

delete.summary: Remove a member from the league
delete.description: Removes a member from the target league. Commissioners use this to manage league membership directly.

delete.summary: Leave a league as the current member
delete.description: Allows the authenticated user to leave a league through their own membership rather than through a commissioner-managed removal flow.

post.summary: Bulk-import members via CSV rows
post.description: Imports member rows for the league and creates invitations or memberships according to the validated bulk payload.

201.description: Result of a bulk CSV member import.

get.summary: List what each league plan allows
get.description: Every league plan, lowest first (FREE, PRO, PREMIUM, PLATINUM), with its caps and features under the current plan settings, for the public Plans page and the comparison a commissioner picks a plan from; also how long the Premium gift every new league starts with runs, and each plan's contest expansion prices from the payments settings. Public: no session is needed, and it holds nothing about any league or user.

200.description: What each league plan allows, how long the Premium gift runs, and what expanding a contest costs on each plan.

get.description: Every payment made in the league, newest first (#987): date, amount in US cents, what it was for, its contest and who paid. While payments are off, each expansion is a $0 line that says it was free; a root admin's gift is a $0 line with its reason. No card data is kept. Commissioners and root admins only.

404.description: CONTEST_NOT_FOUND — no such contest in this league.

get.summary: Get a contest's entry cap and expansions
get.description: The contest's entry cap (the higher of its league plan's and its expansion), its entries counted drafts included, and the bands above its cap on its plan's price list, with what each would cost (#987). Commissioners and root admins only: members never see prices.

200.description: A contest's entry cap, and the expansions its commissioners can choose.

404.description: CONTEST_NOT_FOUND — no such contest in this league.

post.summary: Expand a contest
post.description: Raises the contest's entry cap to one of its offered bands, at once, from its creation until it stops taking entries (#987). While payments are off it is free, and the league's payment history records a $0 line, "free while payments are off". A step up records the band it came from. Commissioners and root admins. 409 CONTEST_EXPANSION_CLOSED once the contest has stopped taking entries; CONTEST_EXPANSION_BAND_UNAVAILABLE for a band not offered; CONTEST_EXPANSION_NOT_ABOVE_CAP when another expansion to this band or higher landed first; PAYMENTS_CHECKOUT_UNAVAILABLE while payments are on, because checkout is not built yet. 400 LEAGUE_DETAILS_READ_ONLY_WHEN_INACTIVE for an inactive league; a root admin can still give an expansion.

200.description: A contest's entry cap, and the expansions its commissioners can choose.

404.description: CONTEST_NOT_FOUND — no such contest in this league.

post.summary: Give a contest an expansion free
post.description: A root admin raises the contest's entry cap to any number above it, free, with a reason, at any time (#987). The league's payment history records a $0 line with the reason. Root admin only. 409 CONTEST_EXPANSION_NOT_ABOVE_CAP when the number is not above the contest's cap, or the contest has no limit.

200.description: A contest's entry cap, and the expansions its commissioners can choose.

404.description: CONTEST_NOT_FOUND — no such contest in this league.

get.description: Returns every squad in the league, active and inactive, each with its owners: the Teams page and Manage teams. A page about one squad reads getLeagueSquad instead.

post.summary: Create a squad in a league
post.description: Creates a squad in the target league for commissioner or member-managed squad participation.

get.description: Returns one squad with its owners: every membership, any status, each with its user. A team page reads this rather than the whole team list.

patch.description: Updates mutable squad fields such as naming and presentation detail for an active squad owner, league commissioner, or root admin.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an inactive squad and cascades related squad-owned data. This route is root-admin only and exists to support QA cleanup flows from the web app. Refused with 400 SQUAD_DELETE_REQUIRES_INACTIVE for an active squad, and with 400 SQUAD_DELETE_HAS_RESULTS for a squad with a place in a finished contest, whose results cups and championships keep.

post.summary: Inactivate a squad
post.description:
Inactivates the target squad, preserves its history, removes its active owners from the league, and revokes its pending co-owner invitations so an old invite cannot revive it. Refused with LEAGUE_LAST_COMMISSIONER_REQUIRED when the squad's owners are every active commissioner the league has. It does NOT touch their user accounts — they can still sign in, and a commissioner can invite them back, which restores their original squad (#218).

**League commissioners and root admins only (#219).** Squad owners may invite and remove co-owners on their own squad, but ending a squad also ends its owners' league memberships, so it is league administration rather than squad management.

post.summary: Add or reactivate a squad owner
post.description: Adds an owner to the squad or reactivates an existing inactive owner membership for an active squad owner, league commissioner, or root admin.

delete.description: Removes the owner relationship between the target user and squad. The backend blocks removal of the final active owner and requires squad inactivation instead.

get.summary: List co-owner invitations for a league
get.description: Returns pending and historical co-owner invitations visible to the current commissioner, active squad owner, or root admin.

post.summary: Invite a co-owner by email
post.description: Starts the co-owner invite flow for a squad. Existing PoolMaster users outside the league may be provisioned immediately; current league members are rejected. An inactive league refuses with 400 `LEAGUE_INACTIVE`. Active squad owners, league commissioners, and root admins may start this flow.

post.summary: Replace an active squad owner
post.description: Guided replacement flow that removes the selected current owner (ending their squad and league membership, as removing an owner does) and starts the same co-owner invite/provisioning flow for the replacement email. Refused when the owner being replaced is the league's last active commissioner, and in an inactive league (400 `LEAGUE_INACTIVE`). A squad owner may replace a co-owner; a league commissioner or root admin may also replace a squad's only owner, and the squad stays active for the replacement.

delete.description: Revokes a pending co-owner invitation so it can no longer be accepted. Active squad owners, league commissioners, and root admins may revoke invitations in their allowed scope.

get.summary: Preview a league invitation by invite code
get.description: Returns the minimal league identity and invitation state needed to render the public `/invite/<inviteCode>` entry flow before or after authentication.

200.description: Invitation preview payload used by `/invite/<inviteCode>` flows.

post.summary: Accept a league invitation using an invite code
post.description: Accepts an invitation for the authenticated user and creates or reactivates a MEMBER membership in the target league. An email invitation can be accepted only by the account whose email it was sent to (400 `LEAGUE_INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH`); an invite link can be used by anyone holding it. An inactive league refuses with 400 `LEAGUE_INACTIVE`.

get.summary: Preview a co-owner invitation by invite code
get.description: Returns the minimal league and squad identity needed to render the public co-owner invitation flow before or after authentication.

200.description: Public preview payload for a team-owner invitation.

post.summary: Accept a co-owner invitation using an invite code
post.description: Accepts a co-owner invitation for the authenticated user and provisions league membership plus squad ownership on the target squad. Only the account whose email the invitation was sent to may accept it (400 `SQUAD_OWNER_INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH`). An inactive league refuses with 400 `LEAGUE_INACTIVE`, and a squad that has gone inactive since the invitation was sent refuses with 400 `SQUAD_INACTIVE`.

post.summary: Register a new account against a co-owner invitation and accept it
post.description:
Creates a PoolMaster account for an invited co-owner who does not have one yet, then joins them to the league and the invited squad — registration, league membership and squad ownership in a single request. Returns the new account with a session, so the invitee is signed in and lands on their squad.

Unauthenticated by design: the caller has no account yet, which is why `acceptTeamOwnerInvitation` cannot serve them. When the invited email already belongs to a user, `createSquadOwnerInvitation` provisions them immediately and the invitation comes back ACCEPTED, so there is nothing to accept and this route returns 400 `SQUAD_OWNER_INVITATION_ACCOUNT_EXISTS`.

The account is created with the address the invitation was sent to; the request carries no email. A co-owner invitation grants league membership, so honouring an address supplied by the caller would let a forwarded invite link admit an unintended person. An inactive league refuses with 400 `LEAGUE_INACTIVE`, and a squad that has gone inactive since the invitation was sent refuses with 400 `SQUAD_INACTIVE`.

201.description: Successful authentication response returned after registration or login.

get.description: Returns the league's current contests: DRAFT, OPEN and ACTIVE, less any DRAFT that can never open: one with an event COMPLETED or CANCELLED, and one closing at its event's start once an event has started. A DRAFT with no events yet is listed, and so is a bracket starting after round 1 or a squares DRAFT with its game until its event finishes, since those close at their round or game. DRAFT contests are listed for the league's commissioners only. With `finishedYear`, returns instead the COMPLETED contests that went final in that championship year (US Eastern), newest first; `listContestFinishedYears` names the years. A single contest is `getContest`. Each contest carries its count of entries that submitted at least one event and its sport events' names and starts, so a list needs no per-event reads. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

parameters.name: finishedYear
parameters.description: List the COMPLETED contests that went final in this championship year, US Eastern, such as 2025, instead of the current ones. The years with any are `listContestFinishedYears`.

post.summary: Create a new contest in a league
post.description: The one way a contest is created. Name a template, supply a configuration, or both: the template seeds the configuration and `configuration` replaces it. A request with neither is refused with 400 CONTEST_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED — there is no platform default. A template that names a sport league (that league's own preset) makes contests only for that league's events: 422 CONTEST_CONFIG_TEMPLATE_LEAGUE_MISMATCH otherwise. Commissioners of the league only.

201.description: Single-contest response. A contest's rules are on the contest-management read (commissioners) and the selection-state read (entries).

400.description: CONTEST_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED when neither `templateId` nor `configuration` is supplied; otherwise a request that does not match the schema.

409.description: PLAN_SPORTS_LEAGUE_LIMIT_REACHED — the league's contests of the new contest's season already use its plan's sports leagues a year, and this event is in another sports league (#947). Budget rules the event cannot run. CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_PRICED — the event's golfers have no prices, so there is no salary cap. CONTEST_BUDGET_UNFILLABLE — the cheapest golfers for every roster place cost more than the cap.

422.description: The event, format or template cannot make this contest. The event: SPORT_EVENT_NOT_FOUND, SPORT_EVENT_NOT_RELEASED, SPORT_EVENT_FIELD_NOT_LOADED, SPORT_EVENT_ALREADY_STARTED. The format: CONTEST_FORMAT_NOT_ALLOWED. The games of a pick'em or survivor contest: CONTEST_EVENT_HAS_NO_GAMES, CONTEST_EVENT_GAME_UNDECIDED, or CONTEST_EVENT_SPREAD_MISSING (a pick'em pool against the spread on a week with a game lacking its spread). CONTEST_SPREAD_NOT_OFFERED: a pick'em pool against the spread in a sport whose pools have no spread (#792). The selection type: CONTEST_SELECTION_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED (the event's sport does not offer it). The configuration: CONTEST_RULES_SELECTION_TYPE_MISMATCH (rules of another selection type than the contest's), CONTEST_TIER_FIELD_OUT_OF_RANGE, CONTEST_BUDGET_FIELD_OUT_OF_RANGE (counted scores above the roster size), CONTEST_CONFIGURATION_INVALID (template missing, inactive, or for another format or selection type), or CONTEST_CONFIG_TEMPLATE_LEAGUE_MISMATCH (the template is one sport league's own preset and the event belongs to another league; a template with no sport league is offered for every league of its sport).

get.summary: List the years a league has finished contests in
get.description: Each championship year (US Eastern) a COMPLETED contest of the league went final in, newest first: the years `listContests` takes as `finishedYear`. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

200.description: The years a league has finished contests in.

get.summary: List the requester's entries in a league's current contests
get.description: The requester's own squad's entries, drafts included, in each of the league's OPEN and ACTIVE contests, each with its status in every event of its contest and without its picks (#1197): one read for what league home, the Contests page's My entries and My team show, however many contests are current. Empty without an active squad in the league. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

200.description: The requester's own entries across a league's current contests (#1197).

get.summary: List the sports leagues a league's contests use in a season
get.description: The different sports leagues of the league's contests of one season, drafts included (#947): what the plan's sports leagues a year counts. Create contest shows the counter and, at the cap, locks the events of other sports leagues. Commissioners of the league only.

parameters.name: seasonYear
parameters.description: The season to count, such as 2026: a contest counts in the season of its first event's year.

200.description: The sports leagues a league's contests use in one season (#947): what its plan's sports leagues a year counts.

get.summary: Show what a league uses of its plan's caps
get.description: What the league uses of its plan's caps now (#972), for the commissioner Plan page: the different sports leagues of this year's contests (UTC), drafts included, and every contest still taking entries with its entries, drafts included, as the entry cap counts them. The page warns before a lower plan whose caps these are over. Commissioners of the league only.

200.description: What a league uses of its plan's caps now (#972), for the commissioner Plan page.

get.description: Returns a contest with its configuration and the tiers it inherits from its event: what the configuration editor reads. Commissioner only. Named for the object it returns, not the role that reads it (#248; was getManagedContest).

put.description: Updates a draft contest's configuration and returns it as getContestConfiguration does. Commissioner only. Refused with 409 CONTEST_CONFIGURATION_LOCKED once the contest is no longer DRAFT: opening it to the league locks its settings for good.

409.description: CONTEST_CONFIGURATION_LOCKED — the contest has been opened to the league (it is not DRAFT), so its configuration can no longer change. CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_PRICED — budget rules on an event whose golfers have no prices. CONTEST_BUDGET_UNFILLABLE — the cheapest golfers for every roster place cost more than the event's salary cap.

422.description: CONTEST_RULES_SELECTION_TYPE_MISMATCH — the rules are of another selection type than the contest's. CONTEST_TIER_FIELD_OUT_OF_RANGE — the tiered rules do not fit the event's tiers. CONTEST_BUDGET_FIELD_OUT_OF_RANGE — counted scores above the roster size.

post.summary: Open a draft contest to the league
post.description: Moves a DRAFT contest to OPEN so league members can see and enter it, and returns it as getContestConfiguration does. Commissioner only. There is no undo: from here its name, configuration and existence are locked. The event's field need not be ready; entries wait on it.

404.description: CONTEST_NOT_FOUND, or SPORT_EVENT_NOT_FOUND when the contest's event is gone.

409.description: CONTEST_NOT_DRAFT — the contest is already open, or past it. CONTEST_EVENT_ALREADY_STARTED — the event's start time has passed or it is IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED or CANCELLED; the draft stays a draft. CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_PRICED or CONTEST_BUDGET_UNFILLABLE — budget rules the event's active field can no longer fill under its salary cap, for example after withdrawals; edit the draft first.

422.description: CONTEST_TIER_FIELD_OUT_OF_RANGE — the stored configuration no longer fits the event's tiers; edit the draft first. CONTEST_RULES_SELECTION_TYPE_MISMATCH or CONTEST_BUDGET_FIELD_OUT_OF_RANGE — stored rules that break their selection type's checks. CONTEST_SELECTION_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED — the event's sport no longer offers the contest's selection type.

put.summary: Set how much a contest counts toward its cup
put.description: Sets how much the contest counts toward its sports league cup and the league championship (#841) and returns it as getContestConfiguration does. Commissioner only.
